mapper.select: SELECT 'QUERY' AS action,a.merchant_request_no,c.channel_code,c.channel_merchant_no,c.credential_ref,i.expected_amount,i.currency,c.return_url,a.version FROM tc_payment_attempt a JOIN tc_payment_intent i ON i.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND i.id=a.intent_id JOIN tc_merchant_channel c ON c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.id=a.channel_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.channel_id=#{channel} AND a.merchant_request_no=#{reference}

SELECT 'QUERY' AS action,a.merchant_request_no,c.channel_code,c.channel_merchant_no,c.credential_ref,i.expected_amount,i.currency,c.return_url,a.version FROM tc_payment_receipt r JOIN tc_payment_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.id=r.attempt_id JOIN tc_payment_intent i ON i.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND i.id=a.intent_id JOIN tc_merchant_channel c ON c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.id=a.channel_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.channel_id=#{channel} AND r.receipt_no=#{reference}

SELECT r.receipt_no,a.id AS attempt_id,c.channel_code,c.channel_merchant_no,r.provider_transaction_no,h.amount,h.currency,c.currency AS binding_currency,(h.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) AS submitted FROM tc_payment_refund_hold h JOIN tc_payment_receipt r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.id=h.receipt_id JOIN tc_payment_attempt a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.id=r.attempt_id JOIN tc_merchant_channel c ON c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.id=a.channel_id WHERE h.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.channel_id=#{channel} AND h.refund_no=#{reference}
